C193.name: Micheweni District
C193.documented: large waves, strong winds, heavy rain, boat accidents, and cholera

area.en: Micheweni: dry north and fishing villages
area.sw: Micheweni: kaskazini kame na vijiji vya wavuvi

risk.en: This area is the driest part of Pemba, where water shortages and dry spells hit households and crops, and fishers face rough seas.
risk.sw: Eneo hili ni sehemu kame zaidi ya Pemba, ambapo uhaba wa maji na vipindi vya ukavu huathiri kaya na mazao, na wavuvi hukabiliwa na bahari chafu.

advice.en: For those living and fishing here, it helps to harvest and store rainwater, plant drought-tolerant crops and stay ashore in strong winds.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi na kuvua hapa, ni vyema kuvuna na kuhifadhi maji ya mvua, kupanda mazao yanayostahimili ukame na kubaki ufukweni upepo mkali unapovuma.

C192.name: Wete District
C192.documented: coastal floods, large waves, heavy rain, and boat accidents

area.en: Wete: hilly clove farms and harbour
area.sw: Wete: mashamba ya karafuu ya milimani na bandari

risk.en: This area has hilly clove farms where heavy rain erodes slopes and floods valleys, and a harbour exposed to storm tides.
risk.sw: Eneo hili lina mashamba ya karafuu ya milimani ambapo mvua kubwa humomonyoa miteremko na kufurika mabonde, na bandari inayoathiriwa na mawimbi makubwa.

advice.en: For those living and farming here, it helps to keep trees on slopes, build away from valley floors and keep boats secured before storms.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi na kulima hapa, ni vyema kuacha miti kwenye miteremko, kujenga mbali na sakafu za mabonde na kufunga vyombo imara kabla ya dhoruba.
